items.text: Tennessee traded All-Pro DT Jeffery Simmons to Chicago on Thursday for two first-round picks; he will not play for the Titans.
Tennessee (Wednesday): WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), RB Tyjae Spears (knee), DL John Franklin-Myers (groin) and P Tommy Townsend (knee) did not practice; WR Calvin Ridley (hip) was limited.
Cincinnati WR Ja'Marr Chase (ankle/rest) sat Wednesday but was in uniform Thursday; Rapoport says the ankle is not significant and he is expected to play.
Cincinnati S Kyle Dugger (quad) is ruled out; TE Erick All Jr. (ACL, IR) and TE Tanner Hudson are out for the season. S Jordan Battle (hamstring) was limited Wednesday.
